summary: Implemented a Pi-native /rorca:run cockpit with live polling, wave-aware story navigation, output/story/run panes, and safe retry/pause/resume/cancel hooks. Rewired the extension command to resolve a run id or spec slug, removed terminal-owning code from shared/run surfaces, and stubbed still-disabled legacy embedded views so the Pi extension safety validator passes cleanly.

remaining_work: Smoke-test /rorca:run inside Pi against a real running pipeline to validate pane updates, polling, and action hooks end-to-end.
Decide whether to add a Pi-native run picker overlay instead of the current latest-run/spec-slug resolution in /rorca:run.
Resolve the unrelated backend TypeScript environment failures if supervisor gating requires all independent validators green.
notes: The new cockpit is Pi-native and validator-safe; legacy memory/direction/workspace/spec-detail embedded views remain intentionally disabled via safe stubs until migrated.
